item.title: 特朗普经常宣布他将停止对伊朗的袭击。但它们不断发生
item.description:
以色列特拉维夫（美联社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周六晚表示，他将停止计划对伊朗发动新的袭击，等待重启谈判以结束战争并恢复霍尔木兹海峡陷入停滞的货运交通。
这是美国总统宣布的一系列声明中的最新一次，先是威胁进行大规模罢工，然后又取消。这种突然的转变是这场持续五个月的冲突的一个决定性特征，这场冲突导致石油和基本商品价格飙升，而迄今为止的公告却因几天甚至几小时后再次发生的袭击而被打乱。
以下是特朗普过去关于暂停对伊朗打击的一些重大声明：
美国和伊朗同意为期两周的停火，以结束 2 月 28 日以色列和美国袭击开始的激烈战斗。特朗普在他为德黑兰设定的最后期限前不到两小时宣布了这一消息，最后期限是德黑兰投降或面临桥梁和发电厂的袭击——他说，袭击将意味着“整个文明将消亡”。
特朗普在停火协议到期前一天宣布无限期延长与伊朗的停火协议。他补充说，调解人要求他推迟袭击，以便给伊朗领导人时间提出更多建议。脆弱的停火一直持续到5月8日，当时美国对伊朗油轮进行了袭击。
在经历了周末对伊朗的可怕威胁后，特朗普表示，他正在推迟计划中的重大军事打击，因为“认真的谈判”正在进行中。“他们似乎很有可能解决一些问题。如果我们能做到这一点而不用轰炸他们，我会非常高兴，”他说。截至 5 月 27 日，美国谈判破裂后，罢工又卷土重来。
经过两天的反复攻击后，特朗普威胁进一步升级，称美国将“今晚非常严厉”打击伊朗，并“完全控制”其石油和天然气工业。几个小时后，特朗普在社交媒体上发帖称，谈判取得了突破，并取消了罢工。
特朗普与伊朗签署了一项初步协议，呼吁永久停止敌对行动并重新开放海峡，并开始为期 60 天的谈判，以就伊朗核计划的未来达成最终协议。特朗普为放弃它敞开了大门。“这是一份谅解备忘录，如果我不喜欢它，我们就会重新向他们开枪、投掷炸弹，”他说。
伊朗袭击海峡商船后，特朗普在土耳其安卡拉出席北约领导人峰会期间对伊朗发动了新的打击。后来，他在表示相信停火已经结束后，再次威胁要“完成对伊朗的工作”。
特朗普表示，他已暂停了两周美国对伊朗每天进行的密集打击，以便为谈判提供另一次机会。在为期 13 天的打击中，随着围绕航线的冲突继续升级，美国军方瞄准了关键的军事和商业地点。作为回应，伊朗向中东地区驻有美军的国家发射了导弹和无人机。
在告诉记者美国将“非常严厉”地打击伊朗后，特朗普在社交媒体上表示，他已经取消了计划中的袭击，并声称中东盟友已达成结束战争的协议参数，包括重新开放海峡。特朗普表示：“基于这一要求，我同意，为了世界未来的利益，也为了一个成功和繁荣的伊朗的生存，取消这次袭击，但前提是能够迅速达成协议。”伊朗国防部长回应称，特朗普的声明让该国“既不感到惊讶，也不被动”，并表示伊朗面对威胁继续保持警惕。

item.title: 德国理查德瓦格纳音乐节人工智能辅助舞台引来一片嘘声
item.description:
柏林（美联社）——在德国东南部小镇拜罗伊特举行的一年一度的理查德瓦格纳音乐节上，一项人工智能实验引起了观众的嘘声，因为它的舞台表演似乎让一些观众感到困惑。
据德新社报道，周六晚上《诸神的黄昏》演出结束时，策展人马库斯·洛布斯和他的团队走上舞台时遭到了嘘声和口哨声。然而，歌手和音乐家，尤其是指挥家克里斯蒂安·蒂勒曼，获得了热烈的掌声。
节日组织者在表演前表示，这将是人工智能首次登上活动舞台，“不是作为一个角色，而是作为一种图像生成力量”。他们说，歌手将成为“光、纹理、历史和关联的视觉沸腾宇宙中的固定点，在爆发、不断变化和相互融合的投影之中。”
人工智能辅助投影包括瓦格纳《指环》之前演出的场景和历史主题，并取自多特蒙德戏剧与数字学院院长洛布斯及其团队预先选择的图像。
据德新社报道，该技术在舞台上投射的拼贴画让观众感到困惑，其中包括德国前总理赫尔穆特·科尔、2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击后的世贸中心双塔以及纪念 1990 年德国统一的特殊邮票。
节日网站称，“每场表演都将是独一无二的——因为图像和联想永远不会停滞不前。”预计还有两场演出。

item.title: 特朗普声称伊朗会谈将于周一开始，以及中东的其他事态发展
item.description:
CAIRO (AP) — After calling off a fresh round of strikes against Iran, U.S. PresidentDonald Trumpannounced that new talks towind down the warwould start Monday, even as Iranian officials claimed their diplomatic efforts were focused on neighboring nations.
Talks between the U.S. and Iran are critical to ending the monthslong conflict and reviving stalled cargo traffic through theStrait of Hormuz, a crucial waterway through which about a fifth of all traded oil and natural gas passed before the war.
But Iran’s foreign ministry said it’s negotiating with Oman, not the U.S., prompting Trump to criticize the country’s leadership, which has grownincreasingly dividedover the war’s endgame.
Trump, who hasmade a habitof threatening strikes on Iran only to dangle the prospect of a last-minute diplomatic reprieve, said Monday that whether “Iran wants to admit it or not, we are, in fact, talking.”
Elsewhere, Israel bombed the Gaza Strip and the Syrian president met in Damascus with the Iraqi Kurdish regional leader over security concerns. In Iran, the government executed two men it claimed were Israeli spies.
Here is a look at the most important developments Monday in the Middle East.
Trump said Sunday that he decided against carrying out major strikes against Iran at the urging of Gulf allies Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
He said a plan was in place for U.S. forces to carry out “the biggest attack since World War II,” but he decided to give diplomacy more time after hearing from key Gulf leaders and fielding requests from unnamed Iranian officials. He did not provide further details or say who would be involved in the talks.
The Iranian Foreign Ministry maintained that the country was not currently holding negotiations with the United States.
Esmail Baghaei, an agency spokesperson, said Monday that ongoing talks were with Oman, the country on the other side of the strait, and were focused only on establishing a temporary route for safe navigation through the channel.
Nine vessels transited through the strait Sunday, most of them using an Iranian-controlled route, according to trade data and analytics platform Kpler.
Trump voiced frustration at Iran’s public posturing.
“Iranian Leadership is unbelievably duplicitous!” the U.S. president vented on Truth Social, his social media platform. “They ask for a meeting, some would say “beg,” talks begin, with more scheduled in the immediate future, and they say, openly and proudly, that they’re not having any discussions, that nothing is being talked about, and they’re only dealing with ‘Oman.’”
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived Monday in Iraq’s holy city of Najaf to participate in the Arbaeen commemorations, an annual pilgrimage for Shiite Muslims, his office said on social media.
Araghchi’s trip comes as Iraq has beenwalking a tightropebetween Iran and the U.S., an act that has only grown more fraught since the U.S. and Israel went to war with Iran in February.
Meanwhile the country’s trade minister headed Monday to Pakistan for an official visit expected to focus in part on ways to ease transit bottlenecks and move more Iranian containers through Pakistani ports during the U.S. naval blockade.
Iranian Minister of Industry, Mines and Trade Mohammad Atabak was scheduled to attend a meeting of the Iran-Pakistan Joint Trade Committee in Islamabad and to meet with Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during the two-day trip.
Syrian interim President Ahmad al-Sharaa and Iraq’s Kurdish regional president met Monday in Damascus to discuss ways of improving mutual cooperation and contributing to regional security.
The meeting between al-Sharaa and Nechirvan Barzani came amid regional tensions as Iranian-backed Iraqi militia groups carried out multiple drone strikes targeting American interests across Iraq, including the country’s Kurdish region.
Syrian state media reported last month that authorities at the country’s border with Iraq thwarted an attempt in June to smuggle weapons believed to have been headed to the Iranian-backed Hezbollah militant group in Lebanon. Hezbollah denied the charges.
Iran’s judiciary said it executed two men Monday after convicting them of spying for Israel during both last year’s 12-day war and the ongoing conflict.
The judiciary’s Mizan news agency identified the two as Omid Behzad and Pouria Safvat, who were accused of providing military coordinates, images and other intelligence used in attacks on Iranian targets. The agency did not specify where the executions took place.
Last week, Iranpublicly hangedtwo men convicted of killing four police officers during nationwideanti-government protestsin January.
Attacks on Gaza by Israel over the weekend left at least 17 people dead, including children, according to hospitals in Gaza.
A strike on a residential apartment in southern Gaza killed three family members, including a 4-year-old child, according to Nasser hospital, where the bodies arrived.
The Israeli military said the strikes targeted militants.
The bombardment comes days after the U.S. and Hamas said a deal was reached for themilitant group to disarm, a potential step toward ending the war in Gaza.
Soaring temperatures in Gaza this summer have turned the makeshift tents sheltering hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians into suffocating ovens. Made of plastic sheets, the shelters trap heat during the day and offer little ventilation, forcing many families to spend hours outside.
The extreme weather compounds an alreadydire humanitarian crisis. With limited access to clean water, electricity and sanitation, overcrowded camps are grappling with conditions that humanitarian agencies warn heighten the risk of dehydration, heat-related illnesses and the spread of skin infections, diarrheal diseases and other communicable illnesses.
“There is no breeze, nothing,” said Aida Abu Hadeesha, a woman displaced from the town of Rafah, near the border with Egypt. “Our kids are suffering.”
Becatoros reported from Athens, Greece and Boak from Washington. Associated Press reporters Julia Frankel in Jerusalem, Bassem Mroue in Beirut and Philip Marcelo in New York also contributed to this report.

item.title: 华盛顿州斯波坎附近的火灾已烧毁 600 栋建筑，迫使 6 万人疏散
item.description:
Wildfiresin eastern Washington stateforced the evacuation of 60,000 people in the Spokane area while destroying at least 600 homes, businesses and other structures, authorities said Sunday.
The fires in and around Spokane, the state’s second largest city, burned about 8.2 square miles (about 21 square kilometers) over the weekend and were among dozens of wildfires across the Western U.S. that stretched the ability of federal, state and local agencies to fight them.
A total of about 390 square miles (1,000 square kilometers) has burned across the state, and some of the fires, including those in the Spokane area, have not been contained.
Washington Governor says he talked to Trump about wildfires
Fire and law enforcement officials said there had been no reports of injuries or people unaccounted for — but they stressed it was early in the response effort.
Officials also said that the evacuees in Spokane included patients at its U.S. Veterans Affairs hospital.
Video from the Spokane area showed buildings on fire, black smoke billowing up near neighborhoods, and the smoking ruins of homes, with only chimneys still standing. Several officials expressed concern that the area does not appear likely to get a break in coming days from the weather, which is expected to remain dry.
“We are not out of danger,” U.S. Sen. Maria Cantwell said during a news conference with federal, state and local officials in Spokane. “The next couple of days will be challenging.”
Investigators had yet to determine how the blazes started.
Spokane was hardly the only place struggling to contain fires.
Crews using bulldozers and helicopters continued for a 10th day to fight a fire that has burned nearly 525 square miles (about 1,360 square kilometers) of grassland in western Idaho and eastern Oregon. The area is home to cattle ranches, and authorities said the fire is threatening more than 600 homes and 800 other structures.
The weather in the area was expected to remain sunny — and dry — well into the week,with temperatures risingto more than 90 degrees Fahrenheit (32 degrees Celsius) on Wednesday. Officials say the fire was caused by lightning.
In central Utah, a massive blaze more than doubled in size over the weekend, jumping from 16 square miles (about 41 square kilometers) to about 56 square miles (145 square kilometers) by Sunday morning. More than 100 cattle have been killed, according to local law enforcement.
Officials called the fire “catastrophic” as heavy winds helped flames jump containment lines overnight. The fire is moving north toward Fillmore, a town of about 2,600 people and the seat of Millard County. Mandatory evacuations were ordered Sunday evening for the southern portion of Fillmore.
The National Weather Service issued warnings about the air quality across the northwest. It issued red flag fire warnings for parts of Utah and Montana and western Nebraska, and extreme heat warnings for the southern parts of Arizona, California and Nevada and northern Montana.
While temperatures Sunday in Spokane were forecast to remain below 80 F (27 C), wind gusts from 35 mph (56 kph) to 45 mph (72 kph) had been expected by the afternoon, said Benjamin Cossel, public information officer for the federal response team from California called in Saturday night to deal with the fires.
“We have weather working against us, and we have terrain working against us,” Cossel said.
There were three fires in the Spokane area: the Old Trails Fire, the Fairview Fire and the Meadowview Fire. Washington Gov. Bob Ferguson declared a state of emergency Saturday, and the National Weather Service issued a“particularly dangerous situation” red flag alertfor eastern Washington.
Cossel said that as it gets warmer during the day, cool air that’s closer to the ground and keeping winds at bay will rise, allowing those winds to move through the area. The Spokane River cuts through the city of about 229,000 people, and there are steep canyons on both sides that channel the wind.
“They push the fire through the canyons, up, up the slopes, and then outside the slopes and around,” he said. “It’s very, very hilly, very, very steep slopes, a lot of canyons that create really turbulent, really challenging sort of wind scenarios.”
Authorities in Spokane set up a shelter at the city’s main convention center. About 400 people were staying there, officials said Sunday.
Spokane County Commissioner Chris Jordan said relatives of his were in an area affected by the fires and that they don’t know if their home is still standing. He said he spoke with them as they were leaving the home.
“They’re in their car and all they can see is smoke everywhere, and it was incredibly scary for so many people,” he said during the news conference.
Heather Rosenstrater, president and CEO of Avista Corp., the area’s electric and natural gas utility, said about 10,000 people were without power Sunday, down from a peak of 30,000. Avista needs to repair two transmission lines, she said, so it’s possible that demand for electricity over the next few days could cause outages.
Meanwhile, several larger fires continued to burn in less populated areas northwest of Spokane, including one about 80 miles (129 kilometers) from the city that has burned about 210 square miles (544 square kilometers). Another fire in eastern Oregon, about 70 miles (113 kilometers) to the northwest in the Stinkingwater Mountains, has burned about 336 square miles (870 square kilometers).
“The whole northwest is heavily impacted right now,” said Keila Vizcarra, the spokesperson for the federal team from California handling what’s been named the Big Grass Fire in western Idaho and eastern Oregon.

item.title: 警方称，爱达荷州快餐店枪击案嫌疑人因自伤枪伤身亡
item.description:
TWIN FALLS, Idaho (AP) — The suspect in a fatal shooting at a fast-food restaurant in Idaho died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound, police said Sunday, crediting an off-duty officer and a citizen with firing shots that diverted him.
Investigators are confident that the gunman, identified as 24-year-old Chad Williams, acted alone during the shooting Saturday at an In-N-Out location in Twin Falls, Police Chief Matthew Hicks said at a news conference.
In all, four people died, including Williams, and seven others were injured at the recently opened restaurant in the southern Idaho city of about 56,000 people. Authorities said Sunday that two of the injured were treated at a hospital and released, three were listed as stable, and two were in critical condition.
Hicks said an off-duty state trooper and an armed citizen — whose identities weren’t immediately disclosed — both fired back and diverted the gunman from the restaurant.
“We believe their actions helped drive the suspect away from the scene, preventing further casualties,” the chief said. “We want to take a moment and commend the actions of the off-duty officer and the citizen, and their heroic action to stop this incident.”
Hicks said detectives are working to determine Williams’ motives, and said the suspect’s family was cooperating fully with law enforcement. Officials asked potential witnesses or anyone with information to contact police.
The chief also warned of misinformation spreading online identifying a different man as the shooter, saying that person had “no involvement in this incident whatsoever.”
Lane Koehn, 34, said he was at a stoplight near the In-N-Out when he saw a person with an AR-style rifle emerge from the drive-thru. A man with a pistol started firing at the shooter.
One of those killed was an employee, the fast-food chain’s owner said.
“My heart is broken, my chest is heavy, my eyes burn from the tears I’ve shed. We lost one of our beautiful Associates tonight,” In-N-Out owner Lynsi Snyder said in a statement released early Sunday on social media. “In-N-Out will be mourning with the families and praying for them as they tread through a very painful season.”
The FBI on Sunday encouraged the public to submit images and videos related to the shooting Saturday in Twin Falls that left seven other people wounded, some critically.
The In-N-Out had opened just about a week earlier, on July 24, as part of the California-based company’s recent expansion to Idaho.
This image provided by KMVT shows the scene of a shooting that started at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant, Saturday, Aug. 1, 2026 in Twin Falls, Idaho. (KMVT via AP)
Snyder did not identify the worker. Officials were still trying to notify relatives of victims and so were not yet releasing the names, ages or other details about the people hurt in the shooting, Twin Falls spokesperson Josh Palmer said Saturday.
Police who responded to the shooting found the body of the suspected gunman in an area near the restaurant, Palmer said.
Palmer said investigators were interviewing witnesses to the shooting. The restaurant is in a busy shopping plaza, and hundreds of people were in the area when it happened around 2 p.m.
Lane Koehn, 34, said he was at a stoplight near the In-N-Out when he saw a person with an AR-style rifle emerge from the drive-thru. A man with a pistol started firing at the shooter.
This still image captured from video by a witness shows the scene of a shooting that started at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant, Saturday, Aug. 1, 2026 in Twin Falls, Idaho. (Kevin Bell Jr. via AP)
He then saw someone in an In-N-Out uniform drag a person, also wearing a uniform, bleeding from a gunshot wound to her chest across the parking lot. The employee, Koehn and the man with the pistol stayed until paramedics arrived for her.
“She was pretty bad off, but I don’t know. I hope she made it,” Koehn said.
He said the shooter fired at least three or four rounds and it was not clear whether or not anyone in particular was targeted.
Video taken by a driver from across the street captured a shooter, who appeared to be dressed in black, walking up to a white car carrying a long rifle, opening the driver-side door and popping the trunk. The person then walked to the trunk and reached inside. At that point the driver who shot the video left quickly, fearing that the man might be getting more weapons.
Twin Falls resident Haley Dodaro, 43, and her mother went to In-N-Out for lunch Saturday afternoon. While waiting in the drive-thru line, they saw people running across the road and workers bolting out of the restaurant. At first, Dodaro thought there might have been a fire, but then a man directing traffic in a reflective vest said there was a shooter.
“So that’s when we knew there was a shooting. People were running out crying and screaming. It was very scary,” Dodaro said in a text message to The Associated Press.
Nayeli Rodriguez, 40, of Burley, was inside waiting for food with her daughters when she heard shots from the kitchen. An employee said it was a shooting and told people to get down. Rodriguez said an older man tried to protect her and her daughters, and they were among the last to run outside.
“We were trying to get as far as we could and some angels let us in their car,” Rodriguez said, also via text message. “I left my car there in the parking lot.”
Twin Falls is about 130 miles (205 kilometers) southeast of Boise and about 40 miles (64 kilometers) north of the Nevada border.
This story was first published on Aug. 2. It was updated on Aug. 3 to correct that Twin Falls is about 40 miles, not 75 miles, north of the Nevada border.

item.title: 密歇根州报告美国前两例与引起腹泻的寄生虫有关的死亡
item.description:
密歇根州卫生官员周一宣布，密歇根州环孢子虫疫情已造成两人死亡，这是美国确认的首例与这种微小寄生虫有关的死亡病例。
密歇根州卫生与公众服务部表示，两人都有潜在的健康状况，可能受到肠道疾病和脱水的影响。该部门表示不会提供有关死亡的更多信息。
据美国疾病控制与预防中心称，环孢子虫是一种微小的球形寄生虫，通常会引起水样腹泻，“伴有频繁且有时是爆发性的排便”。爆发最常发生在春末和夏季。
疾病预防控制中心表示，这种称为环孢子虫病的疾病很少致命。
这种喜热的寄生虫会感染肠道并通过粪便传播。过去，人们因食用接触受粪便污染的灌溉水的水果或蔬菜而受到感染。
环孢子虫病比其他食源性疾病（包括沙门氏菌和大肠杆菌）不太常见。许多病例与特定食物或其他来源无关，多年来，美国很少有环孢子虫疫情的报道。但这一数字大约在十年前开始上升，其中 2018 年和 2019 年的峰值尤其显着。
此前，2019 年是美国报告的环孢子虫病病例最多的一年，约有 4,700 例。
美国疾病控制与预防中心表示，目前已知确诊或疑似病例激增，超过 18,000 例。但 CDC 的数字可能落后于州报告，该报告表明全国范围内的数字超过 20,000
联邦卫生官员已确定九个州的 Taco Bell 门店供应的墨西哥生菜是此次疫情大范围爆发的根源。据 CDC 称，截至 7 月底，与生菜有关的病例数为 1,947 例，其中至少 98 人需要住院治疗。
该机构表示，随着调查的继续，其他“品牌、餐馆、零售商或分销渠道”可能与疫情有关。
美联社驻纽约记者迈克·斯托贝 (Mike Stobbe) 对此作出了贡献。

item.title: 共和党坚持者表示，在就资金达成协议后，他们将支持布兰奇的总检察长提名
item.description:
WASHINGTON (AP) — Two Republican senators who threatened to block acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s confirmation to lead the Justice Department said Monday that they will support his nomination, ending an impasseover plans to create a fundto compensate allies of President Donald Trump.
The endorsement from GOP Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis paves the way for the Senate Judiciary Committee to advance Blanche’s nomination on Tuesday after the Justice Department and lawmakers reached a deal to formally rescind the $1.8 billion “Anti-Weaponization Fund” proposed to settle Trump’slawsuit against the Internal Revenue Service.
Cornyn and Tillis had refused to back Blanche’s bid for the permanent post without official confirmation killing the fund meant to compensate people who believe they were unfairly prosecuted by the Justice Department. Blanche’s written order, issued late Sunday, came after the days of negotiations between the Justice Department and the Republican senators who are leaving Capitol Hill when their terms end in January.
“We want to express our gratitude to Mr. Blanche and his staff for working with us on this, and we look forward to voting to advance his nomination out of the Senate Judiciary Committee soon,” Cornyn, of Texas, and Tillis, of North Carolina, said in a statement.
Blanchehas repeatedly said thatthe Justice Department was scrapping plans for the fund, which sparked bipartisan outcry over the possibility that violent rioters who attacked police at the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, could be considered for payments. But skeptical lawmakers said they were concerned that could be revived without a commitment in writing, especially because Trump has continued to defend the idea.
In his order posted on social media late Sunday, Blanche wrote that the department was confirming “beyond any doubt, that there is no Fund.”
Since the settlement of the president’s lawsuit against the IRS was announced, “No Members were appointed; no funds were transferred; no process for receiving claims was established; no claims were paid,” the order said. “This order establishes, beyond any doubt, that there is no Fund.”
Cornyn and Tillis had also pressed the Justice Department to limit the scope of a separate piece of the settlement that provided broad immunity for Trump and members of his family from tax audits.
Under the deal, the Justice Department clarified in writing that the tax audit immunity agreement “applies by its terms only retroactively” to claims open at the time of the settlement and does not protect the president from examination of future tax filings. It also makes clear that only the parties that brought the lawsuit — Trump, two of his sons, and the Trump Organization — are covered by the tax agreement.
Cornyn and Tillis said in their statement that they were “pleased” with the concessions made by Blanche.
“From the outset, we were clear that we needed a written document addressing our concerns on the IRS audit agreement and the anti-weaponization fund that included constraining the scope of audit protection by limiting it to the parties of the Settlement Agreement and legally ending the anti-weaponization fund,” they wrote.
Democrats, however, noted that the order rescinding the fund doesn’t stop the Trump administration from compensating Jan. 6 rioters through a previously established process that allows people to file claims for damages if they believed they were wronged by the government.
“This supposed ‘deal’ doesn’t prevent payouts to violent insurrectionists in the future,” Democratic Sen. Adam Schiff said in a social media post. Schiff added that it also “leaves in place a tax-immunity deal that could help Trump skip taxes on the $2.3 billion he made last year, and still leaves it vague who and what is covered.”
Blanche’s nomination was thrown into doubt last week after the Judiciary Committeepostponed a votethat had been scheduled for Thursday morning as Tillis and Cornyn said they needed more from the administration before they could provide the necessary votes.
After the Thursday vote was delayed, Trump said in a social media post thathe might pull Blanche’s nominationand resubmit it after Cornyn and Tillis leave office next year. And on Saturday the president threatened to push forward with the fund if the two Republicans blocked Blanche’s nomination.
On Sunday evening, Trump said that people who had faced charges from the Jan. 6, attack on the Capitol and could have benefited from the fund had “their lives destroyed.”
“This would be a reimbursement for the pain that they suffered,” Trump said. “A lot of people like it.”
Blanche, who served as Trump’s defense lawyer in his criminal cases, entered the Justice Department last year as deputy attorney general. He was elevated to the top post after Pam Bondi was fired in April by Trump, who was frustrated by her failure to successfully prosecute his political enemies.
Though Blanche insisted he wasn’t auditioning for the permanent job, he has moved quickly since taking the reins of the department to promote the Trump administration’s agenda and accelerate investigations into the president’s perceived foes.

item.title: 参议员伯尼·莫雷诺表示前女婿马克斯·米勒不应在众议院任职
item.description:
华盛顿（美联社）——周日，美国参议员伯尼·莫雷诺在 X 频道的直播视频中为自己针对家庭暴力的指控进行了辩护，他表示，他的前女婿、美国众议员马克斯·米勒不应该在众议院任职，而应该“寻求专业帮助”。
由于米勒和女儿艾米丽之间激烈的监护权纠纷，莫雷诺近几个月一直在公开场合保持克制，他在一篇长文中表示：“如果当选公职需要任何基本的品格标准，马克斯·米勒就达不到这些标准。他不应该在众议院任职。”
莫雷诺写道，米勒“需要认真的心理帮助。他对我女儿来说是一个危险，他监护我孙女的每一分钟我都屏住呼吸。”
得到唐纳德·特朗普总统支持的米勒周日表示，他将在周三接替他的最后期限之前继续参加连任竞选。民主党人在俄亥俄州东北部的国会席位上看到了新的机会，因为共和党现任议员在与前妻的一场激烈而旷日持久的监护权争夺战中，因家庭暴力指控面临着越来越大的压力。
“我不会退出这场竞选，我会在 11 月获胜，”米勒说道，他否认虐待他的前妻和女儿。
2023 年 10 月 11 日，俄亥俄州共和党众议员马克斯·米勒 (Max Miller) 在华盛顿国会山与众议院多数党领袖、路易斯安那州史蒂夫·斯卡利斯 (Steve Scalise) 会面后退场。（美联社照片/安德鲁·哈尼克，档案）
周日晚上被问及米勒是否应该辞职时，特朗普表示“到目前为止都是指控”。
对米勒的指控多年来一直公开，但随着案件的反复升级，米勒在特朗普第一个任期内担任白宫顾问，受到了越来越多的关注。
艾米丽·莫雷诺表示，米勒在他们结婚时烫伤、殴打并威胁了她。米勒在视频中否认了这些指控，就像他过去一样。
“这令人难以置信，”米勒在查看一系列指控时说道。
米勒还表示，他们两岁女儿的锁骨骨折与他无关，艾米丽·莫雷诺因此联系了当局。根据法庭文件和警方报告，这对夫妇于 2022 年结婚，并于去年完成离婚，他们对受伤的发生提出了不同的理论。《琼斯妈妈》杂志 7 月的一篇文章首次披露了孩子受伤的情况，详细介绍了警方的报告。
米勒在宣布这一消息的同时，还发布了大量与监护权纠纷相关的调查和法庭文件，以及音频和视频片段。
2026 年 7 月 29 日星期三，华盛顿，俄亥俄州共和党参议员伯尼·莫雷诺 (Bernie Moreno) 在国会大厦出席参议院国土安全和政府事务委员会会议时，安东尼·福奇博士 (Anthony Fauci) 发表讲话。（美联社照片/艾莉森·罗伯特）
艾米丽·莫雷诺的发言人斯特凡·米查吉利周日表示，这段视频“可耻”。
“没有哪个慈爱的父母会利用女儿作为公关典当来挽救自己的政治生涯，”米查吉利夫说。“米勒可以对X撒谎和欺骗，但他不能在法庭上宣誓就这样做。我们相信正义将在法庭上获胜。”
参议员伯尼·莫雷诺在周日发表声明之前，他几个月来一直拒绝对具体指控发表评论。上周，一位发言人发表声明称，参议员“不会在媒体上对这些问题提起诉讼，也不会回应毫无根据的公开攻击。”
“莫雷诺参议员的首要任务是他女儿和孙女的安全和福祉，”发言人里根·麦卡锡说。
这位参议员的声明在他的家乡引发了幕后的一些不安，在该州，像米勒这样的特朗普支持的候选人通常会轻松获胜。
米勒的民主党对手布莱恩·波因德克斯特表示，面临此类指控的人“不属于权力殿堂”。
据一位不愿透露姓名的共和党高级官员透露，如果米勒放弃秋季众议院竞选，州众议员迈克·多维拉(Mike Dovilla)、美国海军退伍军人、前总统任命的人事管理办公室成员，以及凯文·考夫林(Kevin Coughlin)，凯文·考夫林(Kevin Coughlin)，凯文·考夫林(Kevin Coughlin)，凯文·考夫林(Kevin Coughlin)，凯文·考夫林(Kevin Coughlin)。
民主党人最近呼吁米勒辞职，要求进行国会道德调查，并建议在秋季向波因德克斯特提供更多帮助。
两年前，米勒以略高于 51% 的得票率赢得连任。

item.title: 苏菲·坎宁安 (Sophie Cunningham) 对变性运动员的立场后，集会围绕 Fever-Lynx 比赛
item.description:
明尼阿波利斯（美联社）——周日，印第安纳州后卫索菲·坎宁安 (Sophie Cunningham) 在明尼苏达州对阵山猫队 (Lynx) 的比赛中，一群批评者和支持者聚集在塔吉特中心球馆 (Target Center) 周围和内部，支持变性人参与女子体育运动。
山猫队教练谢丽尔·里夫在夹克下穿着一件浅蓝色衬衫，上面写着“跨性别孩子属于”，她带领她的球队——WNBA的顶级球队——以108-100战胜了狂热队。看台上的球迷穿着印有“变性孩子属于体育运动”的T恤。
这是继坎宁安最近在 ESPN 上周发表的一篇文章中表示支持禁止跨性别女孩和妇女参加女子和女子运动之后，这是连续第三场引起集会的狂热比赛。
比赛前，坎宁安和里夫在中场进行了交谈。里夫不想透露他们谈话的确切性质。
“我们都知道我们有平台，而且我们都谈到最重要的是教育，”里夫说。“我们有一些共同点，也许有些事情你们有不同意见，就像任何问题一样。我认为这就是你们处理事情的方式。当然，面对面的感觉很好。”
坎宁安在比赛的第一次触球和整场比赛中都受到了观众的嘘声。
球馆外，数十名球迷聚集在入口处。一个人用扩音器一遍又一遍地重复着“保护跨性别女性”。举着标语，上面写着“爱就是真理”和“谢谢你苏菲”。
当被问及她和团队如何处理外部对话时，凯特琳·克拉克赛后说道：“我认为我们非常出色。
“我认为联盟和管理机构应该与运动员合作寻找解决方案，”克拉克说。“我们的重点是篮球。这就是我们所谈论的以及我们如何取得胜利，显然我们今晚没有这样做。因此，我们需要找到一个可以改进的领域。”
坎宁安周五在波特兰表示，她并不担心反对变性人参与女子体育运动的集会会分散热潮的注意力。
“我想每个认识我的人都知道我充满了爱。我很活泼。我爱我周围的人，”坎宁安周五说道。“我喜欢篮球。我喜欢激励下一代并以积极的态度做到这一点。所以我根本就没有想到这一点。我的队友不会想到这一点。”
美联社WNBA：https://apnews.com/hub/wnba-basketball

item.title: 欧洲足球机构欧足联警告国际足联将对因凡蒂诺失败的世界杯抛售计划采取法律行动
item.description:
瑞士尼翁（美联社）——欧洲足球机构欧足联威胁国际足联对詹尼·因凡蒂诺向私人投资者出售未来世界杯利润股份失败的行为采取法律行动，并表示不应销毁任何潜在证据。
周六早些时候，因凡蒂诺向包括约书亚·库什纳 (Joshua Kushner) 的纽约投资公司在内的投资者筹集 42 亿美元的秘密提议被放弃，几天前媒体报道的披露引发了全球的愤怒。
欧足联带头强烈反对，周四，其 55 个成员国联合会开会，同意在该提案有效期间抵制所有国际足联的活动和比赛。
现在，欧足联的律师已通知国际足联，该欧洲机构“正在积极考虑因国际足联提出的 FFE（国际足联前进企业）计划以及所有相关事项而产生并与之相关的法律诉讼、仲裁和/或监管投诉。”
美联社周一看到了纽约德杰律师事务所周五发出的这封信。
这封信点名了 18 名国际足联高管，称他们应保留数据、文件和电子信息作为潜在证据。他们包括常驻苏黎世的因凡蒂诺首席财务官托马斯·佩耶尔和国际足联全球足球发展主管、伟大教练阿尔塞纳·温格。
信中说：“欧足联向您发出正式通知，在收到本通知后，或者在您已经或合理地应该知道预计将进行诉讼的任何较早日期之后，任何相关材料的销毁、删除、更改、隐匿或丢失都可能构成证据的破坏。”
瑞典足协周一证实，欧足联正在积极寻找“替代候选人”担任国际足联主席。下一次选举定于三月举行。
周六，欧足联表示希望结束因凡蒂诺长达十年的主席任期，称他已经失去了世界足坛的信心，“任何选择都不应该被排除”。
几个小时前，因凡蒂诺撤回了一项引起争议的提议，该提议向国际足联的 211 个会员协会一次性支付 2000 万美元，接受期限为 9 月中旬。
国际足联估值为 200 亿美元的 FFE 分拆项目将至少在 2038 年之前控制该足球机构的盈利商业和赛事运营。它承诺在此期间为已经实际拥有这家总部位于苏黎世的非盈利管理机构的 211 名成员提供双倍以上的发展资金。
国际足联首席运营官凯文·拉穆尔周五在给美联社的一份措辞尖刻的声明中表示，这只是一个人的项目，工作人员感觉被他们的老板因凡蒂诺欺骗了。
欧足联律师安德鲁·J·莱万德（Andrew J. Levander）写道，法律诉讼是“合理预期的”，并援引足球利益相关者的观点，认为该计划“从根本上不符合足球的适当治理”。
欧足联对其前雇员因凡蒂诺的反对最为直言不讳，而亚洲足球联合会和中北美洲及加勒比海足球组织也强烈反对因凡蒂诺的计划。
因凡蒂诺的大部分支持来自他在非洲的传统基地，而南美足联则依靠他将2030年世界杯的参赛球队从48支扩大到64支。这将使阿根廷、乌拉圭和南美足联主席亚历杭德罗·多明格斯的祖国巴拉圭获得更多主办权。
因凡蒂诺稳定他已经担任了 10 1/2 年的总统职位的道路尚不清楚。周一，纽约有报道称，因凡蒂诺正在寻求其亲密盟友美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府的支持，可能是在与国务卿马可·卢比奥的通话中。
“@SecRubio 没有计划与因凡蒂诺交谈，今天早上也没有接到电话，”负责全球公共事务的助理国务卿迪伦·约翰逊在社交媒体上发帖称。
自上周二《伦敦泰晤士报》披露以来，这项私募股权计划为因凡蒂诺的命运带来了惊人的转变。
两周前，这位 56 岁的国际足联领导人在世界杯决赛后离开纽约，看来他将在明年 3 月无人反对的情况下连任，第四次也是最后一次任职，直至 2031 年。
分拆业务本可以在 2031 年之后为他创造一个类似于专员的角色，而他的年薪和奖金将远高于他目前担任总裁的 600 万美元。
国际足联在世界杯上通报称，因凡蒂诺已收到 211 个成员国足协中约 200 个的承诺支持信。
这些信件现在很可能在欧洲各地被撤回，威尔士足协率先宣布撤销。
候选人的截止日期是 11 月 18 日，四个月后将在摩洛哥举行选举。摩洛哥是因凡蒂诺最强大的盟友之一，也是 2030 年世界杯与西班牙和葡萄牙的共同主办国。
美联社足球：https://apnews.com/hub/soccerand美联社世界杯报道

item.title: 英国首相表示因凡蒂诺不是领导国际足联的合适人选
item.description:
英国首相安迪·伯纳姆周日表示，国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺不是领导世界足球管理机构的合适人选，以应对现已废弃的普兰托向私人投资者出售世界杯股份的最新影响。
“我不认为他是在世界舞台上领导足球前进的合适人选，”伯纳姆说。“提出的计划冒犯了世界各地的许多人，包括足球界人士，我们不能就这样继续前进，忘记这一点，这是不可接受的。”
周六，欧洲足球管理机构欧足联表示，它对国际足联的领导力失去了信心，这可能为挑战因凡蒂诺主席职位铺平了道路。北美、中美洲和加勒比海足球管理机构（CONCACAF）表示，国际足联领导层“不再把足球放在第一位”。
因凡蒂诺计划通过一家负责运营顶级赛事的商业子公司出售世界杯利润，这一颇具争议的计划被迫让步。
在欧足联 55 个成员国周四同意抵制世界杯和所有其他国际足联赛事后，因凡蒂诺的计划宣告失败。中北美洲及加勒比海足联和亚洲足联也表示反对该计划。
尽管因凡蒂诺做出了让步，但欧足联表示将与其他足协合作，“制定一项计划，确保这种情况不会再次发生”。
“任何选择都不应该被排除，”它说。
虽然因凡蒂诺得到了包括 2022 年世界杯主办国卡塔尔在内的一些协会的公众支持，但伯纳姆的言论进一步证明了他的计划所引发的愤怒。
下一届国际足联主席选举将于三月在摩洛哥拉巴特举行。候选人参加总统竞选的截止日期是 11 月 18 日，即距离投票整整四个月。
詹姆斯·罗布森 (James Robson) 位于 https://x.com/jamesalanrobson

item.title: 阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 退出伦敦音乐剧并暂时淡出公众视野
item.description:
伦敦（美联社）——制片人表示，爱莉安娜·格兰德已退出即将在伦敦举行的一部音乐剧，并计划退出公众视线，以摆脱她面临的严格审查。
格兰德原定于 2027 年在巴比肯剧院与她的《邪恶女巫》联合主演乔纳森·贝利一起主演斯蒂芬·桑德海姆的《与乔治一起在公园里的周日》。
帝国街制作公司周日表示，格兰德将不再是伦敦制作的一部分。Grande 的一位代表告诉《人物》杂志，这位 33 岁的歌手“在完成《永恒阳光》巡演后将淡出舞台。”
声明称：“她期待着健康快乐地结束这次巡演，并以高调结束，然后从面向公众的工作和露面中休息一下，这导致了无休止的、持续的公众监督。”格兰德的代表没有向美联社提供进一步评论。
随着格兰德最近与《邪恶女巫》联合主演伊桑·斯莱特分手、巡演正在进行以及上周专辑《花瓣》的发行，人们的关注度不断增加，引发了网上对她健康和外表的广泛猜测。格兰德此前曾对公众关于她体重的讨论表示不满。
她在 2023 年的 TikTok 视频中表示：“我认为，无论如何，我们应该更温和、更不舒服地评论人们的身体。”
去年年底，在宣传《邪恶女巫：永远善良》时，她转发了 2024 年的一次采访，在采访中她表示，从十几岁起就因为自己的外表而受到批评，这让她感到很不舒服。在 12 月的社交媒体帖子中，她称这段视频是“对所有人的爱的提醒”。
格兰德在 2013 年发行首张专辑《Yours Truly》之前，曾作为 Nickelodeon 的儿童演员而声名鹊起。她曾获得三项格莱美奖，并因在《魔法坏女巫》中饰演格林达而获得奥斯卡女配角提名。
格兰德的下一场音乐会将于周一在芝加哥举行。她的巡演将于 9 月 1 日在伦敦结束。
Empire Street Productions 表示：“我们知道这不是一个容易的决定，她在我们的完全理解和支持下做出了这一决定。”该公司表示，《与乔治一起在公园里的周日》将于明年夏天按计划上映，并且将在“适当的时候”宣布选角。

item.title: 《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》打破《复仇者联盟：终局之战》票房纪录
item.description:
《蜘蛛侠》在票房上击败了《复仇者联盟》。索尼影业周一表示，《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》在美国和加拿大影院的票房收入达到 3.6 亿美元，打破了《复仇者联盟：终局之战》北美首周末票房最高纪录。
索尼周日预计，《蜘蛛侠》首周末将在 4,487 家影院上映，预计净收入 3.55 亿美元，仅略低于 2019 年《复仇者联盟：终局之战》3.57 亿美元的票房纪录。但汤姆·赫兰德主演的第四部《蜘蛛侠》周日的表现比预期要好，最终取得了领先。
索尼影视电影集团董事长兼首席执行官汤姆·罗斯曼在一份声明中表示，“纪录是用来被打破的，但只要我们保持着这一纪录，我们就会对此感到非常自豪。”
在《复仇者联盟：终局之战》之前，没有哪一部电影的国内票房突破 3 亿美元。之前的纪录保持者是 2018 年上映的《复仇者联盟：无限战争》，票房为 2.57 亿美元；以及《星球大战：原力觉醒》（2015 年上映，票房为 2.47 亿美元）。2021 年 12 月，疫情期间，第三部荷兰蜘蛛侠电影《无路可归》以 2.6 亿美元的首映票房跻身榜单，全球票房收入已升至 19 亿美元。
《蜘蛛侠：崭新的一天》和《奥德赛》的高票房组合，由霍兰德、赞达亚和乔·博恩瑟共同主演，也推动了美国和加拿大电影院周末票房的创纪录。
根据 Rentrak 的数据，国内票房总体比去年增长了 15% 以上，迄今为止票房收入超过 62 亿美元。

item.title: 播放内容：《Ted Lasso》、《Billie Eilish》、《Stray Kids》、《You Me & Tuscany》和《The Shards》
item.description:
The return of “Ted Lasso” and Billie Eilish’s immersive concert film are some of the new television, films, music and games headed to a device near you.
Also among thestreaming offerings worth your timethis week, as selected by The Associated Press’ entertainment journalists: the rom-com “You, Me & Tuscany,” a new mini-album from Stray Kids and the new series based on Bret Easton Ellis’ “The Shards.”
— A family is trapped inside their home for years in the new science-fiction thriller “The Last House,” streaming Friday, Aug. 7, on Netflix. Greta Lee and Wagner Moura play parents to two children who find themselves in the mysterious predicament in the Louis Leterrier-directed movie.
— James Cameron and Billie Eilish share the directing credit on the concert film“Billie Eilish — Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live),”which hits Paramount+ on Aug. 6. In her review, AP Music Writer Maria Sherman wrote that “While no movie can serve as the perfect replica of a transformative live music experience … (this) works an immersive magic. Every seat is the best seat in the house in these shots.”
— Halle Bailey plays a professional house sitter who impulsively takes up residence in an Italian villa in the romantic comedy“You, Me & Tuscany,”streaming on Peacock starting Friday, Aug. 7. Equal parts picturesque and improbable, the movie involves a case of mistaken identity and a lie about an engagement that gets in the way of a potentially real romance with Regé-Jean Page. Jocelyn Noveck, in her review for The Associated Press, wrote that it is “a movie as frothy and insubstantial as the foam on a nice cappuccino.”
— Colombian filmmaker Simón Mesa Soto won a prize from last year’s Cannes Film Festival in the Un Certain Regard section for“A Poet,”about a failed writer named Oscar, that will be streaming on Mubi on Friday, Aug. 7. AP Film Writer Jake Coyle, in his review, wrote that “while ‘A Poet’ might remind you of some other films — one would beCord Jefferson’s ‘American Fiction’— it is, like Oscar, steadfastly its own thing. Filmed on grainy 16mm, it’s even rough and dirty around the edges. … But if Soto’s film is loose and gritty, its satire is remarkably precise. This is a farce of creative life where the only pure artistic intention is a joke.”
— The British girl-group greats FLO have found “Therapy at the Club.” At least, that is the promise — and title — of their sophomore album. Expect 16 tracks of R&B-pop bliss. If there’s any wisdom to be learned on the dance floor here, it is because their silky-smooth, three-part vocal harmonies delivered the message.
— It’s hard to underscore just how massiveRavyn Lenae’s2024 single “Love Me Not” was in 2025. The swoony song went mega-viral on TikTok and became the centerpiece of a lot of online conversation, much of which positioned Lenae as contemporary R&B’s saving grace. But a one-hit wonder with only a dance trend to her name she is not. “Blue Island,” her forthcoming third album, pushes boundaries — of genre, of expectation, of public perception. Start with the pop-y “Handle,” with its throwback synths, or the dreamy duet “Reputation” withDominic Fike.
— The JYP EntertainmentK-pop group Stray Kidsreturn with a new mini-album on Friday, “This & That.” The seven-track release kicks off with the full-throttle “Run It,” an alt-hip-hop-pop anthem of epic proportions.
— Hard to believe, but it’s been three years since “Ted Lasso” concluded its third season on Apple TV. The lovably folksy soccer coach (played by Jason Sudeikis) led AFC Richmond to become No. 2 in the Premier League, behind Manchester City. He then resigned to return home to Kansas to spend more time with his son Henry. Now, the Emmy-winning series resumes Wednesday, Aug. 5, with Lasso returning to the U.K. to coach AFC Richmond’s new women’s team. Hannah Waddingham, Brett Goldstein, Juno Temple, Jeremy Swift and Brendan Hunt return with Sudeikis for this continuation of the Lasso universe.
— Ryan Murphy has teamed up with “American Psycho” and “Less Than Zero” author Bret Easton Ellis to adapt Ellis’ autofiction novel “The Shards” for FX. Set in 1981 in Los Angeles, it stars Igby Rigney as a privileged high school senior named Bret, who finds himself both suspicious of and obsessed with a new student (played by Homer James Jigme Gere). At the same time, a serial killer is targeting teens in the area and the kids are becoming increasingly paranoid. The show has a roster of rising talent including Kaia Gerber, Hayes Warner and Graham Campbell. It also debuts Wednesday, Aug. 5, on FX on Hulu.
— It’s gonna be a minute until Prime Video is ready to release “The Summer I Turned Pretty” movie or Season 2 of “Off Campus,” so it’s churning out the YA shows to keep viewers swooning in the meantime. “Sterling Point” is the latest offering from Josh Schwartz and Stephanie Savage (“The OC,” “Gossip Girl”), who are co-showrunners alongside buzzy up-and-coming director and actor Megan Park (“My Old Ass”). It’s about a teen named Annie who inherits her grandfather’s island after his death. The drama begins Wednesday, Aug. 5.
— Dogs have been part of video games since 1984’s “Duck Hunt,” but you don’t often get to control them. Koo, the co-star of“Beast of Reincarnation,”wants to change that. The feisty mutt and his human pal Emma are fighting bloodthirsty mutants and killer robots in a postapocalyptic Japan in the year 4026. Emma swings a mean katana, but she can call upon Koo to leap in and take a bite out of an enemy — or just sniff out treasure. This adventure comes from Tokyo’s Game Freak, best known for the “Pokémon” series, and it’s the studio’s first major project outside that franchise. You can fetch it Tuesday, Aug. 4, on PlayStation 5, Xbox X/S or PC.
— In“Big Walk,”you and up to 11 friends are dropped on a mysterious island, where your goal ... well, I’m not sure what your goal is. You can team up to solve puzzles. You can go for walks. You can sit and watch the sunset. Sometimes you’ll lose the ability to chat with your buddies, so you’ll need to figure out other ways to communicate. Australian developer House House is best known for 2019’s preposterous “Untitled Goose Game,” and its new release aims to transfer that cult hit’s sense of whimsical chaos to a co-op package. The hike begins Tuesday, Aug. 4, on PlayStation 5, Switch 2 and PC.

item.title: 市场干预后美元兑日元大幅走软
item.description:
东京（美联社）——在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和日本财务大臣确认双方都对市场进行干预后，美元兑日元周一大幅走软。
上周晚些时候之前，美元兑日元汇率曾一度升至 163 日元上方，触及 40 年来的高点。监管机构疑似介入后，日元跌破160。
周一早盘，官方宣布干预后，美元兑日元跌至近155.20。这对汇率来说是一个很大的下降。美国东部时间周一早盘，美元兑日元汇率为156.70。
尽管吸引了数以百万计的廉价游客，但日元兑美元的长期疲软一直让东京感到沮丧。由于日本消费的商品大量进口，疲软的货币推高了价格。高油价加剧了这一问题，这给日本首相高市早苗政府带来了压力，要求其采取更多措施来解决生活成本上升的问题。
今年早些时候提高日元兑美元汇率的努力对汇率影响不大。
通常外汇市场决定货币的相对价值，但影响市场走势的因素有很多。
美国和日本之间的巨大利率差距导致投资者抛售日元并买入美元，以利用美元计价资产的较高收益率。日本央行和美联储在上周的会议上均维持利率不变，维持了这一差距。
所以，上周当美元跌破160日元并维持在该水平时，美方就有出手相助的嫌疑。
官员们通常对此类行动保持沉默。但周日，特朗普证实美方提供了帮助，日本财务大臣片山五月也发表声明称，财务省已与美国财政部协调购买日元。
“我们将毫不犹豫地进行进一步的联合干预，”她说。
Astris Advisory Japan 董事总经理兼战略主管尼尔·纽曼 (Neil Newman) 表示，如此公开承认市场干预的情况很少见。他说，最后一个重大例子是 2011 年日本东北部发生大地震和海啸灾难后，政府进行了干预。
当被问及华盛顿为何提供帮助时，特朗普周日表示，“我们与日本有着良好的关系。我们非常强大——在经济上非常非常强大——而他们，你知道，他们的日元走弱，他们想要一点帮助，我们总是支持日本。日本对我们非常好，当然，珍珠港事件除外。”
特朗普表示，美国从干预中获得了“经济利益”，称其为“友谊的信号”。
“这对世界经济也有好处，”他说。
纽曼表示，美元疲软使美国制造的商品更具竞争力，降低了以日元计算的成本，并可能有助于增加美国对日本的出口。
纽曼说：“美国人很少会在这方面与日本合作，但日本和美国之间基本上存在利益一致。”
牛津经济研究院日本经济主管永井茂人在一份报告中表示，这是华盛顿向美国主要盟友提供帮助的一种“低成本”方式，同时也保护了外汇和债券市场的稳定。
永井表示，最新的干预措施似乎比今年早些时候的情况产生了更持久的影响，日元在今年剩余时间里可能会略有走强。
但导致日元长期疲软的因素依然存在。
高市推动将日本食品销售税从 8% 削减至 1%，并大幅增加政府支出。此类举措往往会削弱日元，因为它会加剧通货膨胀并增加日本本已庞大的政府债务。
日本央行缓慢地将基准利率从接近零的水平提高到目前的1%，这是31年来的最高水平，但仍远低于美联储3.5%-3.75%的利率。
永井说，在评估伊朗战争和其他因素对经济的影响时，它可能会继续缓慢地采取任何变化。
与此同时，战争导致的油价飙升以及由此引发的通胀上升使得美联储无法降息。
SPI资产管理公司的史蒂芬·英尼斯(Stephen Innes)在评论中表示，“收益率差异仍然很大，日本的能源进口负担仍然很大，而且日本央行的行动仍然比市场通常要求的要慢，以产生持续的货币逆转。”
库尔滕巴赫从曼谷报道。美联社驻东京记者山口玛丽对此报道做出了贡献。
